body:
## What it does

Examples, runnable code and quizzes, and it keeps going rather than stopping at a fixed syllabus, so the finish line is you being ready rather than the material running out. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @techdevnotes shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
